**Issues are public. Please do NOT post personal data here.** A photo helps a lot, but only attach one you're happy to share publicly.

**Mode** (Plants, Rocks or Coins)

**What Fieldkey said** (the top match and its confidence, plus the next-best matches if you remember them)

**What it actually is** (and how you know, if you can say)

**Photo conditions** (lighting, distance, angle, close-up or whole object)

**Phone model and app version** (Settings > About)
